title: Choose the visual world for Territorios 2.0
question: The roll assigned the railway line diagram. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Línea del día
options.lineage: Trenes Argentinos line strips and station sequence boards
options.thesis: Each day is a train line in its printed-card colour; each salida is a station on it, in time order.
options.viewport: Header with day strip as line-coloured tabs; a vertical line in today's colour with each salida as a station card; the next one is outlined and says 'Próxima · en 40 min'; bottom tabs.
options.risk: If the stripe is drawn timidly it reads as a plain timeline list.

raised.raise: A changed salida keeps its change mark until the member has seen it; nothing updates silently.
State is carried by line form too, not only colour: past stations hollow and faded, cancelled ones struck.
Few type sizes; rank comes from weight and mono numerals, so it stays legible at 200% scale.
Day tabs show each day's extent: one tick per salida under the tab.

options.label: La tarjeta impresa, viva
options.lineage: the congregation's own printed weekly salidas card
options.thesis: The week is the familiar printed card, with full-width coloured day bands and field rows, made live.
options.viewport: A scrolling stack of day bands in print colours; rows show time, place and territories; today's band is first.
options.risk: It is the most familiar option: members recognise it instantly, but it adds little beyond the paper.

options.label: Señal de la próxima salida
options.thesis: The app opens on one monumental sign: your next salida, where, and which territories.
options.viewport: A sticky yellow band shows the next salida's time, corner and territory numbers at large scale; the rest of the week sits below it.
options.case: Wins on clarity (one next decision), but members don't recognise airport signage the way they recognise the printed card.
options.risk: Saturated yellow is tiring across a whole app and clashes with the day colours.

options.label: Pase y tablero
options.thesis: Salidas as a departures board that reranks live.
options.case: Few members fly; a reranking board adds motion without adding clarity.
options.risk: Reads as a costume of an airport.

options.label: Riel de emisión
options.thesis: Everything hangs on one calibrated rail.
options.case: Dark and tiny type fails older members outdoors.
options.kept: State carried by line form, not only hue.

options.label: Horario en placas
options.thesis: One single type size; rank by weight and case.
options.viewport: Raked slides along a goldenrod bed.
options.case: Raked containers hurt scanning; goldenrod bed is decoration.
options.kept: Few type sizes, rank by weight.

options.label: Manual con pestañas
options.viewport: Open manual with a fore-edge tab rail.
options.case: Members don't relate to software manuals; acetate layers add depth noise.

options.label: Catálogo de personajes
options.case: Wrong tone for a congregation's service arrangements.
options.kept: Each person keeps fixed personal details wherever they appear.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean scheduling app: grey list cards, a blue accent, bottom tabs.
canonCard.viewport: Today's salidas as a list of cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any calendar app; drops the day-colour code members know.
